phen.effect: multiplying two primes is easy, but finding them from the product is not

public-key-encryption.flag: Maths the job carries out (rule 22); no number-theory card, so a key-effect gap. Own job 'protects' as for Cylinder locks.

spreadsheet.flag: VisiCalc ran on the Apple II, so Personal computer is the device it's carried out with (rule 3). No nameable effect.

slots.note: Key part with no card; Taq polymerase came in 1988.

phen.effect: heat parts DNA's two strands, and matching strands pair up again as it cools

pcr-dna-copying.flag: Base pairing is shared with CRISPR (guide RNA pairs with DNA) and would suit DNA sequencing; 2 new cards here. Primers are made by Gene synthesis, which is production (rule 4).

slots.note: Key part with no card.

insecticide-treated-bed-nets.flag: Mesh may be polyester rather than nylon; Nylon is the only synthetic-fibre card. The village-wide drop in malaria is about the disease and its spread, not an effect the net works by (rule 25).

phen.effect: a drug jams an enzyme so a body process slows

statins.flag: Shared gap with Antiretroviral HIV therapy (2 new cards). Own job could be 'prevents disease' (it cuts the risk of heart attacks); followed Beta blockers. The mould it came from is how it was found/made, not an ingredient worth a gap.

phen.effect: chemicals carry signals between nerves

antidepressants-ssris.flag: Rule 25: the body process it works with. Blocking the reuptake pump has no card; not shared.

phen.effect: a reaction drives a current
lithium ions slip in between the layers of a crystal and out again

lithium-ion-battery.flag: Follows Lithium battery's lithium slot and effect. Intercalation is the key effect, no card. Cobalt-oxide cathode and graphite anode left off (Cobalt would be a weak 'is an ingredient' in an object; graphite has no card). Lithium battery not a slot (rule 6).

phen.effect: a cell follows genes put into it

genetically-modified-crops.flag: No slots: inserting the gene (Agrobacterium, gene gun, Genetic engineering) is how it's made (rule 4), and the borrowed gene varies by crop (Bt toxin is only the common example). Could add 'is an ingredient: gap Borrowed gene' if a material must show ingredients.

phen.effect: a drug jams an enzyme so a body process slows
a chemical kills the germ but not the patient

antiretroviral-hiv-therapy.flag: Enzyme inhibition shared with Statins (2 new cards; both key). The individual drugs (AZT, protease inhibitors) have no cards. Chemotherapy may be redundant with enzyme inhibition; drop one if so.

streaming-video.flag: Uses batch 1's new job 'compresses data'. Buffering has no card.

fracking.flag: Own job follows Oil wells / Coal mining. Oil wells may fall under rule 8 (what the technique is used on); drop it if so. Key effect (fluid pressure splits rock, sand props cracks open) has no card and I couldn't name one that isn't the card itself; left off.

robotic-surgery.flag: A practice made of another practice (rule 3). Camera sits with Keyhole surgery. 'cuts' for the robot arms is the nearest job; no 'manipulates' job.

cloud-data-centres.flag: Joule heating is a waste the cooling deals with, not an effect it works by.

phen.effect: braking runs the motor as a generator, turning motion back into charge

electric-car.flag: Induction is a different effect from the motor's own (a magnet pushes a current), so allowed (rule 23). Same effect as Hybrid car's regenerative braking.

slots.note: Key part with no card.

phen.effect: the guide RNA pairs with the matching letters of DNA
the cell repairs a cut in its DNA, disabling or rewriting the gene

crispr-gene-editing.flag: Base pairing shared with PCR. Restriction enzymes (existing gap on Recombinant DNA) is close to Cas9 but cuts only at fixed sites; kept separate.

self-driving-cars.flag: Car slot by rule 7 (Waymo's driverless fleet is electric Jaguars; earlier test cars were hybrid). Cameras left off to keep it tight. Signal delay sits with Laser rangefinder and Radar.

large-language-models.flag: Own job 'writes' (it answers, writes and translates); 'computes' or 'communicates' would also do. Training on text is how it's made (rule 4); data centres kept because it also runs on them.
